Anwar White (born c. 1982) is an American dating coach, author, and academic administrator. He is the founder of Get Your Guy Coaching and previously served as the Program Director for the Master of Management in Retailing (MMR) at McGill University's Desautels Faculty of Management.
White has been a contributor and subject of profiles in national media outlets including Essence, CNBC, Rolling Stone, and Business Insider.
Early life and education
White was born in Southern California and raised in Georgia. He attended Carnegie Mellon University from 2000 to 2004, where he studied German, African-American history, and statistics. In 2010, he received a Master of Business Administration (MBA) from Columbia Business School.
Career
Retail and academia
White's early career included roles in wholesale sales and strategic planning for several retail brands, including Uniqlo, Versace, and Tom Ford. In 2019, he joined the Desautels Faculty of Management at McGill University to lead the Master of Management in Retailing (MMR) program. During the COVID-19 pandemic, he served as a media commentator on retail consumer behavior for Canadian outlets such as CTV News.
Relationship coaching
In 2015, White founded Get Your Guy Coaching, a firm providing relationship advice primarily to Black and Brown women. His career transition from the corporate retail sector to relationship coaching was profiled by CNBC in 2024.
White's coaching approaches, including concepts described as "CEO energy" and "intern energy," have been featured in lifestyle and business publications. His work has also been discussed in Rolling Stone and Refinery29 in the context of the professionalization of the dating industry.
Media and publications
White is the author of 31 1-Minute Stories (2017) and the host of the Get Your Guy Coaching Podcast. In 2025, he was featured in Essence discussing social methods for meeting romantic partners. He has also appeared on ABC News Live and was quoted in The New York Times regarding dating trends.
